name: Shiraishi Tomomi
source:
A girl who transferred into the academy as a classmate.

She has a quiet, gentle personality and is characterized by her large black-rimmed glasses. Not very social, she always spends time alone.

She was a very inconspicuous presence in class, but... One day, a chance encounter with the protagonist completely changes the situation.

She seems naive about sex, but is actually a shy pervert with a strong curiosity.

[From [url=http://www.ps-web.net/tryset/A002/03_chara.html]official site[/url]]
